module.title: Delegated Access and Scoped Infrastructure Users
module.business_purpose: Lets hospitals, offices, nursing facilities, diagnostic units and pharmacies associate additional users and lets doctors delegate limited work to secretaries, assistants, nurses or billing staff without sharing credentials.
